products.name: Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Tenant-to-Tenant Migration (1:1 Domains) — Commercial
products.short_description: Move every mailbox from one Microsoft 365 tenant to another and cut the primary domain over 1:1 — with mail-flow coexistence and zero data loss. A complete, phased migration runbook (Assess → Plan → Prepare → Pilot → Migrate → Cutover → Validate → Decommission) driven by Quest On Demand, with tested PowerShell. Self-guided, fixed price.
products.description:
From two tenants and a stuck domain — to one clean, validated mailbox estate

Tenant-to-tenant Exchange migrations go wrong in predictable ways: mail flow splits during the move, the primary domain won't leave the source tenant because objects still reference it, Outlook clients won't reconnect, and free/busy breaks across the org. This solution is the exact, ordered runbook for a 1:1 domain Exchange Online tenant-to-tenant migration — pre-stage and delta-sync mailboxes from the source tenant to the target, keep mail flowing with coexistence connectors, then perform a controlled domain cutover (clear references, remove from source, add and verify in target, re-stamp addresses, cut MX and Autodiscover) — validated at every gate.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a migration consultancy. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can execute end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell (Exchange Online / Microsoft Graph) for discovery, validation, status reporting, coexistence setup, and safe remediation.

  • Simpler — one ordered runbook across eight phases; every object you create is named (migration project, waves, service accounts, connectors) and reused verbatim through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter. A comparable tenant-to-tenant migration engagement runs well into five figures; this is a fraction of that, reusable on every future tenant move.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Plan → Prepare → Pilot → Migrate → Cutover → Validate → Decommission) with explicit pass/fail gates and an acceptance gate proving mail flow, content parity, free/busy, and a verified domain before you scale.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the source→target 1:1-domain model, coexistence, and tooling (Quest On Demand, with native MRS / ShareGate / BitTitan as alternatives).
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (target licensing, dual-tenant admin, migration service accounts, tooling, domain/DNS control, routing domain, MFA exclusions, identity mapping) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing — plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Runbook — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths: prepare the target, connect both tenants, configure coexistence, pilot, migrate in waves with delta passes, perform the 1:1 domain cutover, validate, and decommission.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — source-tenant discovery, pre/post validation (item-count parity), migration status/throughput reporting, safe remediation (re-stamp addresses, re-permission), and a coexistence-connector builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices (delta passes, DNS TTL lowering, wave sizing, rollback).

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each migration feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next tenant move, acquisition, or divestiture.

The bottom line

Every mailbox migrated to the target tenant, the primary domain moved 1:1, mail flow preserved throughout, and access validated at every gate — executed by your own team on a fixed budget.

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.

    • EXOMIG-Remediation.ps1 — Safe post-migration remediation in the TARGET tenant:
